description: Tracked 27aDay buy link for one marketplace source (source_kind and source_id from get_verified_offer(s), the offer's source ids). Returns a members.27aday.com/go URL carrying a one time ticket issued to your API key; hand it to the shopper unchanged. The link opens the retailer; no purchase or account action happens here. Free with a key. May return 503 when disabled.
name: get_buy_link
